name: Reflection
short: Reflection AI's first-party API (OpenAI-compatible, api.reflection.ai) serving its open-weight Beam 1.0 — free during the public beta with daily usage limits; Apache 2.0 weights also available for self-hosting.

plans.name: Public beta API
plans.notes: First-party endpoint api.reflection.ai (OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions). Allocations reset daily at 12:00 AM PT; requests past the limit are declined until reset. Some organizations must verify a credit card in Billing before API keys can be used (developers.reflection.ai/authentication). No per-token price published; Reflection may change limits or end the beta at any time.
